The rear of the animal lacks clear definition, appearing somewhat melted or fused with the background turbulence. While consistent with underwater photography, in an AI evaluation context, this lack of edge coherence at the extremities is a structural weakness. I will adjust the artifact score to reflect this ambiguity at the tail/hind-flipper region.
